retrievalProfile.description: A split-screen composition featuring a desaturated, gritty outdoor portrait above a solid black footer with high-contrast, layered sans-serif typography.
excludeWhen: script or serif typography is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical split layout where the top 60-70% is a high-contrast black and white photograph of a central figure in an urban setting, and the bottom 30-40% is a solid black block containing two levels of contrasting typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's dark clothing anchors the center of the frame against a textured, lighter background.
A thin white horizontal line separates the photographic field from the typographic footer.
The primary text is thin and white, while the secondary text is bold and colored (red).
The perspective of the alleyway creates a subtle leading line toward the subject's head.
coreInvariants: Monochrome or highly desaturated photographic upper section

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot of a male figure, centered horizontally, occupying the middle third of the photographic section.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's dark t-shirt provides a central weight that bridges the photo and the black footer.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, moves down the body to the thin white divider, then scans the large white text followed by the bold red text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense foliage and urban textures fill the sides of the photo, while the footer is strictly functional space.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast with crushed blacks and bright whites; color is reserved exclusively for the secondary text.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses ultra-light or hairline weights with wide tracking.
Secondary text uses extra-bold, condensed proportions.
Perfectly vertical stems and circular curves in the light weight.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' in the primary text has a low crossbar.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme weight contrast (hairline vs. black) and width contrast (normal vs. condensed).

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric clarity for the top and heavy impact for the bottom.
Classic geometric pairing with a condensed industrial secondary font.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photograph of a man in a black t-shirt standing in a gravel alleyway with overgrown trees. Leave the bottom 35% of the frame as a solid black rectangle separated by a 1px white line.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Typeset the artist name in a large, white, hairline geometric sans-serif centered in the black block. Below it, typeset the title in a bold, condensed, red sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the photo strictly monochrome or desaturated?
Is there a clear horizontal divider between the photo and the text block?
Is the top text significantly thinner than the bottom text?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names
Do not replicate exact facial features
Do not use specific brand logos on clothing

avoid: Low contrast between subject and background

postGenerationChecks: Verify the red text is condensed and bold
Ensure the white text is hairline weight
Confirm the subject is horizontally centered
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait (B&W, High Contrast) + Solid Black Footer + (Hairline White Sans + Bold Red Condensed Sans)
